components.title: Schema migrations: follow_ups columns, session_reflections, migration runner
components.description: Adds user_chosen and display_text to follow_ups, creates session_reflections with its index, and introduces a numbered SQL migration runner tracked by a schema_migrations table. Foundation for every verb that reads or writes commitments and reflections.

components.title: Expand BehavioralSignals with the ~15 new patterns from Section 11
components.description: Implements the new behavioral signals (specification artifact, error-naming follow-up, four knowledge-gap subtypes, iterative refinement, plan-mode invocation, scaffolding artifact, TDD marker, recipe pattern, context-and-instructions pattern, graded verification depth, repeat-task signature, code-comprehension turn, tool/agent ladder progression) on top of the existing signals.py. Extends BehavioralSignals dataclass in a backwards-compatible way (new fields default to 0) and ships fixture-based positive/negative tests per signal.

components.title: Per-session augmentation vs automation classifier (aug_auto.py)
components.description: Implements praxis/behavior/aug_auto.py, a single cheap-tier LLM call per session that classifies the session as augmentation, automation, or mixed (with confidence). Integrates into the orchestrator's pass-1 path and gates on API-key availability so the rest of the pipeline still runs offline.

components.title: Longitudinal cadence detector (cadence.py)
components.description: Implements praxis/behavior/cadence.py to compute the cadence panel inputs: most-weekdays-active streaks and a sustained-use vs binge classification across a rolling window. Reads scored-session history from the existing storage layer; no schema changes.

components.title: Repeat-task radar detector (repeat_task.py)
components.description: Implements praxis/behavior/repeat_task.py to surface substantively-similar requests recurring across sessions. Per the spec's two options, this component takes the simpler 'cluster_sessions + text-overlap' route (no embedding dependency) and emits candidate clusters with reclaimable-time estimates.

components.title: praxis commit: weekly focus picker with three suggestions + free text
components.description: Implements the `praxis commit` CLI verb. Builds a five-option prompt (three system-generated suggestions + 'keep last week' + free text), with suggestion sources drawn in priority order from the current headline moment's suggested_alternative, the two weakest dimensions' canonical drills in coach.py, and the prior week's commitment if still in flight. Persists the user's choice into follow_ups with user_chosen=True and display_text set to the verbatim string. Also rewrites Copilot static instruction files on commit-change.

components.title: praxis nudge: single reader for the active commitment with three output formats
components.description: Implements the `praxis nudge` CLI verb as the sole code path that reads the current commitment for any cue surface. Supports `--format claude-code`, `--format codex`, and `--format text` (default), and throttles per-surface using ~/.praxis/.last_nudge.

components.title: praxis reflect: 30-second post-session check-in
components.description: Implements the `praxis reflect` CLI verb, including the interactive in-terminal prompt, the threshold gate (>=2 turns AND >=60s elapsed), the --session-end / --non-interactive-fallback flags used by hooks, and persistence into session_reflections.

components.title: praxis install-coach / uninstall-coach: per-tool detection, idempotent hook merging, symmetric teardown
components.description: Implements the bootstrapper that wires praxis nudge / praxis reflect into Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Copilot. Detects each tool, prompts per-tool (--yes / --all / --tool flags), merges hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.codex/hooks.json idempotently using a Praxis-managed sentinel key (since JSON forbids comments), and writes the Copilot user-level instructions file. uninstall-coach removes only Praxis-managed entries.

components.title: Rename praxis week -> praxis review, rewrite masthead with commitment + reflection rollup
components.description: Renames the public verb `praxis week` to `praxis review` (and the internal cmd_week to cmd_review), rewrites the digest masthead to lead with commitment status, reflection self-report counts, and the data-vs-report gap prose, and updates both HTML and terminal renderers. The internal run_weekly orchestrator function name is preserved per Section 3.

components.title: Report panels: behavioral patterns, aug/auto, cadence, repeat-task, verification calibration, spec adoption, context-engineering depth, knowledge-gap distribution, tool/agent ladder
components.description: Adds the nine Section-12 panels to both the HTML and terminal digest renderers. Wires the inputs through reports/adapter.py from the signals, aug_auto, cadence, and repeat_task modules. Each panel renders with literature-anchored labels rather than community percentile comparisons (per Section 12).

components.title: README + `praxis --help` rewrite: coach-first everywhere, drop 'scorecard'
components.description: Rewrites README.md with the coach-first lead, the four-step loop, the new install-coach instructions, and the 'what's under the hood' section that re-positions the rubric as the evidence layer. Reorganizes `praxis --help` so loop verbs (commit, nudge, reflect, review, install-coach) lead and secondary verbs are grouped under 'More'. Ensures every claim maps to a Section-14 primary source.
